subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a first-class secure Tailscale/MagicDNS onboarding path in the iOS first-run flow now that main has a newer onboarding refresh?
rationale: The patch is useful and proven, but it changes first-run product flow and gateway security posture and now conflicts with current main, so automation should not decide the final UX/security direction.

options.title: Sponsor secure Tailscale rebase
options.body: Rebase this work onto current main, preserve the secure MagicDNS/Tailscale Serve path and raw 100.x block, and rerun focused iOS proof.

options.title: Narrow to recovery/security copy
options.body: Carry only the password-missing recovery and raw-IP guard pieces if the first-screen chooser is no longer desired.

options.title: Close as superseded by current onboarding
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers decide the merged onboarding refresh is sufficient and no first-class Tailscale entry path should be added now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor secure Tailscale rebase
recommendation.body: Rebase this work onto current main, preserve the secure MagicDNS/Tailscale Serve path and raw 100.x block, and rerun focused iOS proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Tailnet route and pairing work makes this the closest product/security ownership signal for the Tailscale onboarding choice.
